title: “Cultural additivity” and how the values and norms of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism co-exist, interact, and influence Vietnamese society: A Bayesian analysis of long-standing folktales, using R and Stan
reasoning: The paper performs a quantitative Bayesian analysis on the interaction and coexistence of religious and philosophical values (Buddhism, Confucianism, and Taoism) in Vietnamese culture by examining their representation in longstanding folktales.
